Business_Rule: Every lead must have a unique Lead ID
A lead can have only one active sales executive
Every new lead must have a lead source
Every assigned lead must have a follow-up date
Converted leads must have a conversion date
An inspection must be linked to an existing lead
An inspection must have a scheduled date
An installation can be scheduled only after quotation approval
Installation status must follow defined workflow stages
Every support ticket must have a unique Ticket ID
Resolved tickets must have a resolution date
